review_method: Read source, documentation, retained helper definitions, native report/stage source and nine-pin inventory; Python standard-library AST parsing/hashing only. No imports, prepared script/tests, native, geometry/output replay, network or Git.

review_checks.closed_input_binding: Actual external integer RC0/3 and authoritative supplied hash map required. Every consumed cap/map/fixed/native payload is a regular file and must have an exact expected hash before assessment, then all consumed hashes are rechecked. CLI additionally binds the exact external hash-map file; this is not lifecycle authentication.
review_checks.closure: RC0 requires exactly four payloads, RC3 report.json only, with no extras or symlinks. RC2 is refused.
review_checks.codec: Exact SURF1 header/count/length, complete raw 24-byte coordinate rows, finite binary64 converted to exact Fraction, numeric coordinate uniqueness, complete bounded nondegenerate unique oriented faces and no orphan points are inherited from the hash-checked selected pure read helper.
review_checks.planar_topology: Entire edge incidence must be one- or oppositely oriented two-face; every vertex link is one connected path on the boundary or one cycle in the interior, duplicate link edges refused. Full graph connectedness, Euler0 and exactly two disjoint directed cap loops are checked. Original cap additionally requires every original vertex on its boundary.
review_checks.map_and_boundaries: Success requires sorted unique bounded raw map sources, all-source idempotence, same-original-cycle targets, and unchanged vertices of fixed triangles. Complete original/reported/mapped oriented cycles and every output boundary segment are associated; no new boundary vertex is allowed.
review_checks.provenance: Every mapped retained old ID occurs exactly once; every retained coordinate is original byte-for-byte; remaining coordinate origins are UINT64_MAX. Oriented fixed triangles must each appear once with exactly their original face IDs and cannot be relabelled new; all other face-source entries must be sentinel.
review_checks.exact_quality_units: All output faces are exactly z0 and strictly negative-Z. With signed 2D determinant det and squared-edge sum S, q^2=12 det^2/S^2; q>=2/29 is exactly 2523 det^2>=S^2. Uses exact Fractions from binary64 throughout. Exact area is -sum(det)/2 in mm^2 under the source mm convention; full face area equals mapped boundary area and native mapped/embedded rational fields, while original area is checked separately.
review_checks.report_counts: Success checks complete output/provenance, raw map identity/nonidentity and fixed counts, exact unique boundary-plus-fixed constraint count, all request/insertion/no-insertion accounting, new-point count, final exact poor count and native after-quality face counts. Typed nonnegative integer counters reject booleans; finite native minima and explicit shape observations remain attributed.
review_checks.stage_refusal: Native stage order and observed guard prefixes match bac6102f: original0, mapped1, fixed-CDT2, no-edge3, rounded4, complete5. RC3 requires no exports, status rejected_no_candidate, noncomplete stage and no credited final shape success. It does not require successful map/fixed semantics for bound invalid-association/loop refusal inputs, and credits no later initialized counters.
review_checks.scope: Complete coordinate/quality/combinatorial checks do not independently establish polygon coverage or geometric nonintersection. Native active-shape observations may be unresolved despite a passing weaker final q gate; exact output quality is assessed independently. There is no full-head assembly, keeper/CDT replay or physical admission.

important_limits: Independent saved-output assessment must use separately authenticated original input/output hashes and actual external return code. This source review does not authenticate a lifecycle or a newly self-generated manifest.

Native scalar quality minima, before poor count, active default-shape counts, no-edge insertion causes/history, geometric self-intersection and polygon/domain audits are observations rather than independently replayed algorithms here.
No native output has been assessed in this review. Source clearance does not establish cap acceptance, a head candidate, solver admission or manufacturing qualification.
